{{Quote|Bootop! Bootop, ves?''"<br />"''Vickerman, vickerman?''"<br />"''Yeah, vickerman. Bootop.|Miner and Mimbanite|<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Bootop''' was a [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] slang term that referred to an act of degradation where a [[Mimbanite]] would drop to its belly and lick the grime and mud from a [[miner]]'s boots. They would often be forced to do this to earn "[[vickerman]]," or [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="SotME" />
